```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(lme4)    # For mixed effects models
library(simr)    # For power analysis
library(ggplot2) # For plotting
library(dplyr)   # For data manipulation
library(tidyr)   # For reshaping data
library(lmerTest)
```
Load and clean heatmap trials data
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(here))
source(here::here("analysis", "scripts", "00_setup.R"))

if (!file.exists(cfg$out_clean_heatmap)) {
  stop("Run 01_clean_trials.R first.")
}

heatmap <- readRDS(cfg$out_clean_heatmap) %>%
  mutate(attention = factor(attention, levels = c("single", "dual")))

participant_accuracy <- heatmap %>%
  group_by(participant_id, attention) %>%
  summarise(heatmap_accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

phone_sdt <- if (file.exists(cfg$out_clean_phone)) {
  readRDS(cfg$out_clean_phone) %>%
    transmute(participant_id, d_prime = d_prime)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(participant_id = unique(heatmap$participant_id), d_prime = NA_real_)
}

accuracy_eligibility <- participant_accuracy %>%
  left_join(phone_sdt, by = "participant_id") %>%
  mutate(
    heatmap_acc_ok = heatmap_accuracy >= cfg$rt_min_accuracy,
    phone_sdt_ok = dplyr::case_when(
      attention == "dual" ~ !is.na(d_prime) & d_prime >= cfg$sdt_min_dprime,
      TRUE ~ TRUE
    ),
    include_for_plots = heatmap_acc_ok & phone_sdt_ok
  )

eligible_ids <- accuracy_eligibility %>%
  filter(include_for_plots) %>%
  pull(participant_id)

heatmap_filtered <- heatmap %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% eligible_ids)
```

### fit the model
```{r}
heatmap_filtered$attention_c<- case_when(
  heatmap_filtered$attention == "single" ~ -0.5,
  heatmap_filtered$attention ==  "dual" ~ 0.5
)
heatmap_filtered$label_condition_c<- case_when(
  heatmap_filtered$label_condition == "fewer-up" ~ -0.5,
  heatmap_filtered$label_condition ==  "greater-up" ~ 0.5
)
heatmap_filtered$lightness_mapping_c<- case_when(
  heatmap_filtered$lightness_mapping == "light-more" ~ -0.5,
  heatmap_filtered$lightness_mapping ==  "dark-more" ~ 0.5
)

# Build 4 blocks from stimuli_number:
# 0-19 -> 1, 20-39 -> 2, 40-59 -> 3, 60-79 -> 4
heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number <- as.numeric(heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number)
heatmap_filtered$block <- dplyr::case_when(
  heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number >= 0  & heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number <= 19 ~ 1,
  heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number >= 20 & heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number <= 39 ~ 2,
  heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number >= 40 & heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number <= 59 ~ 3,
  heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number >= 60 & heatmap_filtered$stimuli_number <= 79 ~ 4,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
)
heatmap_filtered$block <- as.factor(heatmap_filtered$block)

# Numeric centered block covariate for mixed model / simulation convenience
heatmap_filtered$block_num <- as.numeric(as.character(heatmap_filtered$block))
heatmap_filtered$block_c <- scale(heatmap_filtered$block_num, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[, 1]


m1_all_blocks <- glmer(
  correct ~ label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c*attention_c + block_c +
    (1 + label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c | participant_id), 
  data = heatmap_filtered,
  family = binomial("logit"),
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(m1_all_blocks)

# Model using only first two blocks (stimuli_number 0-39)
heatmap_first2 <- heatmap_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(block_num), block_num <= 2)

m1_first2_blocks <- glmer(
  correct ~ label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c*attention_c + block_c +
    (1 + label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c | participant_id), 
  data = heatmap_first2,
  family = binomial("logit"),
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(m1_first2_blocks)

```

### Simulation using mixedpower

```{r}
if (!require("devtools")) {
    install.packages("devtools", dependencies = TRUE)}
devtools::install_github("DejanDraschkow/mixedpower") # mixedpower is hosted on GitHub

# load library
library(mixedpower)

model <- m1_first2_blocks # use first-two-block model for power simulation
heatmap_first2$participant_id_num <- as.numeric(factor(heatmap_first2$participant_id))
data <- heatmap_first2 # data used to fit the model
fixed_effects <- c("label_condition_c","lightness_mapping_c","attention_c","block_c")
simvar <- "participant_id_num" # which random effect do we want to vary in the simulation?


# SIMULATION PARAMETERS
steps <- c(20, 40, 60, 80) # which sample sizes do we want to look at?
critical_value <- 1.96 # which t/z value do we want to use to test for significance?
n_sim <- 50 # how many single simulations should be used to estimate power?


power_analysis_results <- mixedpower(model = model, data = data,
                        fixed_effects = fixed_effects,
                        simvar = simvar, steps =steps,
                        critical_value = critical_value, n_sim = n_sim)

power_analysis_results

# multiplotPower(power_analysis_results)
multiplotPower(power_analysis_results, ppi = 300, filename = "../output/power_analysis_acc.png")

```
